news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹14.08 (vs ₹7.53 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹14.08 (up from ₹7.53 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹2.59b (up 93% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹198.4m (up 106% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.7% (up from 7.2% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 18%
news.body: After last week's 18% share price gain to ₹223, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 16.9x. Average trailing P/E is 23x in the Medical Equipment industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 72% over the past year.
